title: Q-PULSE-1: the tick decides from its own records whether it is bootstrapped, whether every loop ran, and whether it is critical
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every tick (step selfknow); every cron run of the dashboard and site Workers (watchers)
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/pulse.js::measureIgnition
**Status:** open

code-task: repo=ultrastable/ultrastable path=seed/worker/src/pulse.js
code-anchor: PULSE-1

Measured on the live org database 2026-11-15 19:00 UTC: 144 of 144 tick slots ran in 24 h with 11/11 steps, yet nothing compared that with what the cron expects; metrics held 0 rows (the liveness set was never seeded on tenant 0); the nine loops after the tick shared one error handler and only the sweeper left a row; tick-stalled was probed by the tick itself and no other Worker watched the clock. pulse.js adds a beat row per loop run, a row per tick step, the slot ledger, the ignition ladder (seeded, ticking, instrumented, loops, acting, closing, verified = bootstrapped, critical, self_sustaining) with a log of stage changes and a self-filed blocker item, self-seeded liveness metrics, and /internal/pulse called by the dashboard and site Workers, which runs a tick when the newest one is older than two intervals.

size: M

**Closing probe:** node --test seed/worker/test/pulse.test.js; live: GET https://ultrastable.io/live carries ignition.stage
